profile.name: 变温实验控制后端与界面组件
profile.name_en: Variable-Temperature Experiment Control Backend and GUI Component
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于协调 Keithley 2400、Keithley 2182 和 Lakeshore 350 的连接、配置、温度斜坡控制、测量采集以及实验界面状态管理，适合变温电学测量流程。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component that coordinates connection, configuration, temperature ramp control, measurement acquisition, and GUI state management for a Keithley 2400, Keithley 2182, and Lakeshore 350 in variable-temperature electrical measurement workflows.

registry.name: Variable Temperature Measurement
registry.description: Variable Temperature Measurement Backend是一款表征设备，主要功能包括停止、加热、参数配置、启动、扫描、日志记录。支持Signal, Slot, create widgets等操作。
